events.headline: SCHMID announced QuantumLine P+ for panel-level copper filling of through-glass vias.
events.mechanism: Bottom-up electrodeposition fills through-glass vias in glass-core substrates.
events.claimedChange: The manufacturer reports void-free filling at aspect ratios up to 50:1. Independent qualification and volume yield were outside this source.

coverageGaps.description: This bounded review covered the manufacturer’s launch. Customer qualification, comparative test conditions and production yield remain open.
